evidence.quote: We do not study pipelines such as Agentless [47], as the defined pipeline denotes the agent’s strategies. We also do not include Refact [38] due to known persistent technical issues during setup and execution.
We will support additional agents upon request as the industry evolves from single-agent to multi-agent systems, e.g, multi-agent research system in Claude.ai [7]
We make no claim that our heuristics, and hence, identified anti-patterns are complete.
The heuristics are orthogonal to our design, i.e., more heuristics or even specific inefficiency patterns can be added later.

We believe Graphectory opens several research directions, which we plan to explore as the next step: Developing structure-aware program analysis tools for symbolic navigation, targeted context retrieval, and AST-based editing to reduce the inefficiencies exposed by Graphectory.
